That helped, but now another part of the performance, routing, timing, or editability feels worse.
Reference the exact prior test, state what the result strengthens or rules out, and recommend at most one next experiment.

Explain naturally and connect the lesson to this principle: Moving notes does not always move every non-note event unless Logic is told to include related MIDI data; controller curves can become detached from the notes they were meant to shape.

That helped, but now another part of the performance, routing, timing, or editability feels worse.
